resources.string: Not enough free space: about %1$s needed, %2$s available.
GamePort is offline: a game cannot be downloaded without a connection to Steam.
GamePort is updating itself. Try again once it has restarted.
Steam\'s Android build of this game contains no APK.
The downloaded APK could not be read.
This game needs Android %1$s and this headset runs Android %2$s. The download is fine: the game asks for a newer system than this device has.
GamePort can lower what the game asks for so that it installs. Games often ask for more than they use, so this may well work — but the game may also fail to start, or run badly.
This game is started in a way that needs the newer Android for real, so there is nothing to lower: it cannot run on this headset. A newer one (Android 11 or later) would take it.
A different version of this game is already installed (for example the Meta Store one). Uninstall it first.
GamePort is not allowed to install apps on this device. Allow it to install unknown apps, then try again.
Android asked you to confirm the install and got no answer. On a headset that window opens outside the game, so it is easy to miss. The download is kept: try again and accept it.
This device refused to install the game%1$s. That is a rule of the device, not a problem with the download.
GamePort needs access to all files to place this game’s data on this device. Once it is allowed, the install can go on.
GamePort needs the storage permission to place this game’s data on this device. Allow it, then try again.
This game’s data could not be placed on this device. The game stays incomplete, and the downloaded data is kept to try again.
A log of this failure was saved as Download/%1$s. Connect this device by USB to copy it off.
Closing this window does not stop the patching. Some games are patched without any confirmation and others ask for one: it is a constraint of the game, not of GamePort.
A game left unconfirmed, or without room, can be patched again from its page.
Waiting for other downloads to finish…
Preparing the game for Steam… this can take a few minutes
Installing… a confirmation may be asked on screen
Putting the files of the game in place… it can be played right after
The tour can be started again at any time from Settings > Help.
